own_solution.law: Thevenin equivalent seen by the capacitor: R_th = R1 R2/(R1+R2); V_C(t) = V_th (1 - exp(-t/(R_th C))); t_0.9 = R_th C ln 10
assumptions: ideal battery, ideal capacitor, uncharged at t = 0
switch in series with R1, closed at t = 0

notes: R_th = 4.7*6.8/11.5 = 2.7791 kOhm; tau = 2.7791e3 * 22e-6 = 61.141 ms; t = tau ln10 = 0.14078 s. With 37 uF: tau = 102.83 ms, t = 0.23677 s. The emf sets V_final = E R2/(R1+R2) but cancels from the fractional time. Variants: T77C0/TC55C both 7.5 V; TE837/T6164/TDA93/T1015 all 15 uF; TA387/T7FFF both 'small amount'. Consistent.
